تسرين (form I)
# تَسُرِّينَ (tasurrīna) /ta.sur.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of سَرَّ (sarra)
# تُسَرِّينَ (tusarrīna) /tu.sar.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of سَرَّ (sarra) and سُرَّ (surra)
# تَسَرِّينَ (tasarrīna) /ta.sar.riː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of سَرَّ (sarra)
